name: SWaT Water Chlorine Concentration (AIT202)
description: Chlorine concentration in Stage 2 after chemical dosing. Too little chlorine → biological growth; too much → toxic. Checks whether concentration stays within disinfection band.

elements.name: Chlorine Concentration
elements.description: Residual chlorine after NaOCl dosing. Controlled by dosing pump P203. Uncertainty from dosing pump variability and sensor response time.

uncertainty.source: SWaT AIT202 normal operation: WHO guideline 0.2–0.5 mg/L free chlorine for disinfection; SWaT operates slightly above this (target ~0.5 mg/L). Std estimated from published SWaT anomaly detection analyses showing tight clustering around setpoint.

elements.name: Minimum Disinfection Chlorine Level
elements.description: WHO Guidelines for Drinking-Water Quality: minimum 0.2 mg/L free chlorine residual

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(AIT202) = AIT202 if AIT202 >= AIT202_min, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The WHO minimum chlorine residual guards the concentration uncertainty set; values below 0.2 mg/L indicate inadequate disinfection.
